title: Outlook: custom organisation properties on profile cards
summary: Hold: the licensing paragraph incorrectly dismisses the general connector prerequisites for this feature, despite listing those requirements in the licensing field. The roadmap facts, opt-in default and documented calls are supported; the connector gallery route needs a small clarification.

claims.claim: The included licensing model reflects the connector's general Microsoft 365 licensing prerequisites, not a separately published feature-specific licence.
claims.quote: Your tenant must have Microsoft 365 licenses. The surfaces available to your users (Microsoft Search, Microsoft 365 Copilot grounding, Copilot Chat agents) and the connector types you can deploy depend on your organization's licensing.

claims.claim: The connector prerequisites page does not explicitly mention people-data connectors.
claims.quote: Searched: people data connectors custom profile card properties licensing price meter quota Microsoft 365. Read the complete Prerequisites for deploying connectors page; it names synced and federated connectors, not people-data connectors.

claims.claim: Because the prerequisites page does not name people-data connectors, it should not be treated as a licence statement for this feature.
claims.quote: This article covers the prerequisites that apply to synced and federated connectors. Your tenant must have Microsoft 365 licenses.
claims.fix: Replace 'That page does not mention people-data connectors, so do not treat it as the licence statement for this feature.' with 'These are the general connector prerequisites; a licence requirement specific to the new custom profile card properties is not yet published.' The people-data build guide documents ingestion and indexing, and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/connectors/overview describes people connectors as providing a synchronized view; they are not outside the general connector requirement.
